summary: Iteration 15 - Bloque 2 onboarding/edit-profile/details/privacy end-to-end validation. ALL 22 backend pytest tests PASSED (includes TestOnboardingLite 8 new tests covering prompts 1..6 bounds, detail fields + privacy switches, /me/completeness endpoint, clear_public respect for show_height/show_children/show_zodiac/show_modes). FRONTEND verified: /app/perfil renders profile-completeness (90%), profile-completeness-percent, profile-completeness-cta, and profile-details card ('BUSCA · DETALLES' - Estatura 178 cm, Sin hijos, Cáncer) for demo1. /app/perfil/editar renders edit-details-section, edit-height, edit-children-si|no|prefiero_no_decir, edit-privacy-section, toggle-show-height/children/zodiac/modes, edit-prompt-add (add→3→4 prompts, remove→back to 3), edit-height persists after save (172cm survived reload). /app/descubrir shows discover-details 'BUSCA · DETALLES' with Estatura 175 cm + Signo Cáncer on a profile with fields. Public profile /app/usuario/{demo10_id} loads correctly but pp-details is (by design) NOT rendered because demo10 seed has no height_cm/has_children/zodiac and modes hidden -> DiscoverDetailsCard/DetailsCard return null when items empty (correct behavior, not a bug). Onboarding page shows 'Paso 1 de 9' confirming 9-step flow. All testids verified in source: ob-prompt-add/remove-N, ob-height, ob-children-si|no|prefiero_no_decir, ob-show-height/children/zodiac/modes. REGRESSION clean: admin panel /admin loads with tabs (dashboard/reportes/usuarios/actividades/grupos), /app/chats loads, /app/grupos shows 4 groups. Zero console errors during regression sweep.
action_items: Documentation nit: review_request references /app/u/{id} but actual route is /app/usuario/:id (mismatch was only in the request payload, code is fine).

Optional: seed demo profiles (demo10 etc.) with height_cm/has_children/zodiac so pp-details/discover-details render in default demo state for QA visibility (currently only user-registered content triggers the card).
critical_code_review_comments: MODE_ICON constant still duplicated across EditProfile.jsx, Onboarding.jsx, PublicProfile.jsx, Profile.jsx - hoist to lib/icons.jsx (carried over from iteration 14).
DetailsCard (PublicProfile.jsx) and DiscoverDetailsCard (Discover.jsx) render nearly identical logic - candidate for extraction to a shared <DetailsCard/> component in components/ui to avoid drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all bloque-2 UI hooks verified, regression clean
